title: Reset a Locked-Out User's Password via CoreID Admin Console

purpose.text: L1 escalation runbook for Solandra Corp: an authorized agent with the CoreID Password Reset Admin role locates a locked user, verifies caller identity via the 2-of-4 checklist, generates a temporary password with force-change-at-next-sign-in enabled, and resolves the ticket with an audit note. The temporary password is relayed verbally over the verified phone line and is never sent by email, chat, or ticket comment.

scope.text: Applies to password_reset operations and authorized agents.

roles.responsibility: Executes Reset a Locked-Out User's Password via CoreID Admin Console

steps.action: Search the CoreID user directory by employee ID to locate the account and confirm its lock status.
steps.expected_outcome: Extract response.found to variables.user_found, response.user_id to variables.user_id, response.status to variables.account_status, response.manager_name to variables.manager_name, and response.department to variables.department
steps.quote: Search the CoreID user directory by employee ID to locate the account and confirm its lock status.

steps.action: Verify the caller's identity against the CoreID checklist (minimum 2 of 4 items: employee ID, manager name, department, phone last 4). No one-time code is sent.
steps.expected_outcome: Extract response.verified to variables.identity_verified, response.matched_count to variables.matched_count, and response.matched_items to variables.matched_items
steps.quote: Verify the caller's identity against the CoreID checklist (minimum 2 of 4 items: employee ID, manager name, department, phone last 4). No one-time code is sent.

steps.action: Generate a temporary password for the locked user with force-change-at-next-sign-in left enabled.
steps.expected_outcome: Extract response.temporary_password to variables.temporary_password, response.force_change_at_next_sign_in to variables.force_change_enabled, and response.status to variables.password_status
steps.quote: Generate a temporary password for the locked user with force-change-at-next-sign-in left enabled.

steps.action: Log the resolution audit note (identity checks matched, temporary password issued, force-change enabled) and set the ticket to Resolved.
steps.input: {"ticket_id": "{{entities.ticket_id}}", "resolution_note": "Admin-mediated password reset completed. Caller identity verified ({{variables.matched_count}} of 4 checks matched: {{variables.matched_items}}). Temporary password issued via CoreID. Force-change-at-next-sign-in: enabled. No OTP sent - admin-mediated reset per policy. Temporary password relayed verbally over verified phone line."}
steps.expected_outcome: Extract response.status to variables.ticket_status and response.audit_logged to variables.audit_logged
steps.quote: Log the resolution audit note (identity checks matched, temporary password issued, force-change enabled) and set the ticket to Resolved.
